mission: Mid-valley. Ben feels all three operations simultaneously — Veraine's calculated amplified ritual, Torin's expanding personal void, their own resonance not yet begun. Three operations pulling the Force in three directions. The Scar widens by a visible centimetre. Sera and Kael take positions flanking Ben; he speaks the word that starts their attempt.
why_now: The climax's physical geometry has to be rendered here before the discordance of sc3 can land. All three operations competing on the same wound, and the trio has to begin before the sun moves.
conflict: The environmental pressure is cumulative. The wound amplifies emotion; concentration is a physical cost. The Scar widens as two of the three operations build momentum. The group's operation is the one not yet running.
turning_point: Ben says 'Now.' The trio reaches for each other through the Force. The operation begins.
opening_hook: Ben watches the Scar widen — a centimeter, maybe two. Enough to be visible. Enough to be terrifying.
closing_hook: Ben: 'Now.' He reaches for Sera and Kael through the Force. Three traditions. Three wounds. One chance.
emotional_trajectory: Environmental overwhelm -> focus through chaos -> the call to begin

stakes.personal: Ben committing to the resonance — no more preparation, no more theory
stakes.interpersonal: Three people trusting each other with their lives and their Force connections
stakes.external: Three operations competing at the wound site — only one can succeed

setting: Veranthos — mid-valley position, Scar visible, Torin visible, Veraine's ritual visible
sensory_details: The Scar widening as a visible seam; Veraine's ritual an organised distortion at the Scar's base; Torin's technique a moving void descending the ridgeline; the trio's position a triangle of reaching without yet combining; sweat, wind, the smell of air that has been sealed for a thousand years
action_beats: Ben watches the Scar widen by centimeters and feels all three operations pulling the Force in different directions
Sera and Kael take positions flanking Ben, hands outstretched, the resonance formation assembling
Ben reaches for Sera and Kael through the Force and speaks the word: 'Now.'
notes: The three simultaneous operations are the highest-density sensory passage in the book. Render each as a distinct Force-texture — Veraine's calculated and directed, Torin's personal and expanding, the trio's three-toned and not yet chord. Rotate vocabulary into acoustic (keys, notes) and hydraulic (currents, counter-currents) families rather than handrail or cage; lean on the force_mechanics active_technique vocabulary for Torin's void. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, narrate the phenomenology as theory. He feels three directions at once; he says 'Now.'
